title: Geospatial frontends and real-time intelligence platforms
description: A source-linked comparison of globe viewers, situational awareness dashboards, GIS platforms and software for building geospatial frontends.

notes: Products are not all direct substitutes: application frameworks and backend services are included to compare complete solution options.
Open-source software does not imply that basemaps, imagery, feeds or hosted services are open or free.
Live object positions do not imply live satellite imagery. Availability, coverage, latency, pricing and terms depend on each provider.
Descriptions are qualitative starting points, not a feature guarantee or an independent security assessment.
scope.expansion_guidance: Add one object per product using the existing fields, stable unique ids and source URLs. Use null for unknown license identifiers; distinguish software licensing from data and service terms. Review claims and update last_reviewed when making substantive changes.

products.name: Google Earth
limitations: Proprietary ecosystem
Imagery is not a continuous live satellite feed
products.data_and_service_terms: Google imagery and services are subject to their own terms.

products.name: God's Eye View
best_for: Immersive exploration of public geospatial signals
strengths: Combines multiple public feeds on an interactive globe
limitations: The project describes itself as experimental, not production-hardened
Feed coverage and freshness vary; some layers require keys
products.data_and_service_terms: Code is MIT licensed; imagery, photorealistic 3D tiles and individual feeds have separate terms, quotas or costs. Some bundled data has additional restrictions.

products.name: World Monitor
strengths: Combines news, infrastructure, markets and geographic signals
limitations: Not primarily a photorealistic globe
Modified network deployments can trigger AGPL source-sharing obligations
products.data_and_service_terms: Upstream sources and optional hosted or premium services have separate terms.

products.name: ArcGIS Earth
strengths: Supports KML, 3D Tiles and OGC services
Includes measurement, elevation and visibility tools
limitations: Proprietary software
Live intelligence workflows require suitable data and potentially other ArcGIS services
products.data_and_service_terms: The application is free to download; access to particular data and ArcGIS services can have separate account, license or usage requirements.

products.name: ArcGIS Velocity
strengths: Integrates live feeds with ArcGIS maps and dashboards
Supports continuous analytics and comparisons with historical observations
limitations: A service rather than a standalone globe frontend
Requires ArcGIS and appropriate service and data access
products.data_and_service_terms: ArcGIS subscriptions and third-party feed agreements may apply; verify the terms for each deployment.

products.name: NASA Worldview
strengths: Many layers are available within hours of observation
limitations: Imagery availability and resolution vary by layer
Not primarily a live aircraft or vessel tracking dashboard
products.data_and_service_terms: Review the project license and the terms and attribution requirements of individual data sources.

products.name: Copernicus Browser
strengths: Browse Copernicus mission imagery and create visualizations
limitations: Not a general-purpose live intelligence dashboard
Coverage and observation frequency depend on the selected mission
products.data_and_service_terms: Copernicus data and service access are governed by their respective terms and quotas.

products.name: QGIS
best_for: Working with local and remote GIS datasets
limitations: Not a ready-made global live intelligence dashboard
Requires GIS expertise and data configuration
products.data_and_service_terms: Software and each dataset or service have separate licenses and terms.

products.name: ShadowBroker
strengths: Aggregates many operational and public data feeds
limitations: Operational setup and security review are necessary
AGPL obligations and provider access restrictions require review
products.data_and_service_terms: Feeds can require keys and have their own licensing and usage restrictions.

products.name: OSIRIS
limitations: Some feeds require keys or have restricted access
Forks can differ in capabilities and maintenance
products.data_and_service_terms: MIT applies to the referenced project code; third-party sources have separate terms.

products.name: TerriaJS
best_for: Publishing and exploring multiple GIS datasets
strengths: Open framework for data-rich mapping applications
limitations: Requires deployment and data integration
Not a preconfigured live intelligence feed aggregator
products.data_and_service_terms: Data sources, basemaps and hosted services have separate terms.

products.name: CesiumJS
best_for: Visualizing terrain, 3D cities and dynamic data
limitations: A development library, not a complete dashboard
Imagery, terrain and 3D tiles require separate data sources
products.data_and_service_terms: CesiumJS is free for commercial and non-commercial use; Cesium ion and third-party assets have separate terms and pricing.
